description: Say what feeds each goal, **several in one call**. **One feed per goal, never both**, so nothing counts twice: either a **Money moved category** — a transaction categorized under it is a deposit into the goal, read from the bank — or, with `from_holding: true`, **the rows that name its default holding**: every buy or sale of that holding inside an account that holds things (`set_transaction_holdings`) is a deposit, and the bank transfer that brought the cash there feeds nothing — or, with `from_transfers: true`, **the confirmed transfers into the bank or cash account whose own Cash is its default holding**: each transfer pair (`answer_transfers`) arriving there is a deposit and one leaving it a withdrawal, after its Was already there; off unless asked, since a main account takes transfers that are not for a goal. A broker’s cash is no such feed. Categorizing is the only step, and a row re-categorized elsewhere takes its deposit with it. One goal per category, per holding and per account; the category must be a Money moved one (a transfer or a saving, not a spending category), and the goal needs a default holding for the money to sit in: `default_holding` sets it, in the same entry or on its own, as the Goals form’s "Where is the money?" does. `category: null` stops either feed, and removes the deposits it had derived. Money you set aside by hand (`record_deposits`) and what was already there are never touched. `savings` shows what a holding’s rows put in, against the cost basis a reading printed. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

commit.description: Default false. False previews the batch; true writes it.

goals.description: One entry per goal. Up to 60 in a call.

category.description: A Money moved category, by id or by path from `category_tree`; null to stop any feed. Leave it out to change only the default holding, or with `from_holding`.

default_holding.description: Where is the money: an existing holding from `savings`, by id, by name, or as "place · holding" when two share a name; null for "not said yet". Leave it out to keep the one it has. `create_goals` and `record_deposits` make new holdings.

from_holding.description: True: fed by the rows that name its default holding, instead of a category. Not with `category`.

from_transfers.description: True: fed by the confirmed transfers into the bank or cash account whose own Cash is its default holding, a transfer out a withdrawal. Not with `category` or `from_holding`.

goal.description: The goal, by id or by name.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: set_goal_deposit_categories
title: Point goals at their deposits
